page_title: Rewrite: free text rewriter and document editor

sources.entry: Rewrite - Rewrite text, fix grammar, and edit Word, LaTeX and PDF files. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Rewrite
summary.one_liner: A free offline text rewriter and document editor that rewrites text, fixes grammar, and edits Word, LaTeX, PDF and Markdown files.
use_cases: Rewriting AI-generated drafts to read more naturally
Fixing grammar and spelling in essays
Editing Word, LaTeX or PDF documents without breaking formulas
Converting documents to Word, PDF, HTML or Markdown
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an app that rewrites whole documents at once, with light, medium or strong rewrite levels, and lets you accept or reject each change. It opens and saves .docx, .doc, .odt, .rtf and Markdown files and can save output as PDF, HTML or Markdown. For LaTeX it says maths and commands are left untouched and only prose changes. It also offers a live PDF preview, merging and reordering PDF pages, highlighting and drawing, and in-place text editing. The FAQ says text stays on the user's computer and no account or trial is needed.
notable: Rewrites whole documents at once, with accept or reject per change
Leaves LaTeX maths and commands untouched while rewriting prose
Works offline; text stays on the user's computer
Source code reuse allowed with credit; selling it is not allowed
caveats: Installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows shows an 'Unknown publisher' warning
Other systems require building from source via a row on the page; only listed platforms are named
Page claims it passes AI detectors, which is not verified here
